_comment: Dated snapshots for standards.html's timeline. Each entry freezes, as of its date, the site's language-switcher count and the published accessibility target — a historical record, not a live query. The page's live sections above the timeline always recompute the current numbers from i18n.js directly; this file only grows by appending a new entry when the published standard moves or the site's own posture changes. Never edit a past entry's values after the fact — append instead, the same discipline changelog-data.json uses.
